risks.impact: A non-black-box final adversarial PASS can carry an unreferenced BLACK_BOX_OBSERVATION and use it as the evidence required to close a Minority Report, despite the documented all-test-evidence binding rule.
risks.trigger: Any non-BLACK_BOX_VERIFIER message supplies kind BLACK_BOX_OBSERVATION through a bundle:// locator; the validator only collects the role-expected test kind, so this evidence is omitted from declared_test_evidence.
risks.mitigation: Reject BLACK_BOX_OBSERVATION for non-black-box roles, or compute declared test evidence from both TEST_REPORT and BLACK_BOX_OBSERVATION and require exact unique test references; mirror the rule in JSON Schema and add a negative regression test.
risks.residual_risk: Low after both manual-validator and schema parity tests prove the cross-kind variant fails closed.

recommendation.reason: The 20-path baseline diff is confined to AGENT-R1-5 docs/control tooling; no ERP business or product-test path, Schema/Migration, D-112 runtime table reuse, UAT/production/deployment change, or PHASE4-TASK03 unfreeze was observed.
